issues.problem: Context 6 used bare 如雨后春笋 with no verb (如雨后春笋，年轻人争相投稿), which reads as incomplete; the idiom normally takes 如……般 + 涌现/出现.
issues.action: Rewrote as 如雨后春笋般涌现; English unchanged.

issues.problem: Context 4 (他总觉得别人帮他是天经地义的) fits the near-synonym 理所当然 at least as well, so it does not single out this idiom.
issues.action: Replaced with a duty-beyond-question context: 治病救人是医生天经地义的职责，不能看病人有没有钱。

issues.problem: The near diff said 水落石出 pictures the truth emerging 'bit by bit', which is not the point of the idiom; the point is that it comes out fully after investigation.
issues.action: Reworded the diff: 水落石出 stresses the truth coming out after digging and fits 查个水落石出.
